about.title: Organic products born from certified organic farms
about.p1: Ecoandes was born to bring the BIO pantry from its origin to your table: wholemeal flours, legumes, seeds, superfoods, spices and derivatives, always from organic farming.
about.p2: We work directly with trusted producers and select batches with the best traceability. We are committed to bulk formats: from 500g for the home to 20kg for shops and bakeries.
about.certP1: Our products carry European BIO labels (Euro Leaf) and national certifications such as ES-ECO-023-MA. Each batch is verified with periodic analyses and controls.
about.certP2: We believe in a good food economy: sustainable for the planet, fair for the producer, and transparent for the end customer.
about.intro: We are a company that exclusively sells certified organic foods, wholesale in bulk format or retail.
about.value2: All our products are BIO certified.
about.value3: We are committed to organic and sustainable agriculture.
about.value4: We adapt to your needs. Different formats available.
about.slogan: Committed to organic production and nutrition!

certifications.intro: At Ecoandes, we only work with products that meet the most demanding standards of European organic farming. These are the labels and controls that support every item in our catalog.
certifications.card1Desc: All our suppliers are audited at least once a year by the corresponding control body.
certifications.card2Desc: Each batch has a code that allows tracking its origin, harvest date, and processing.
certifications.card3Desc: We comply with the maximum residue limits of Regulation (EU) 2018/848. Most batches show 'not detected' in analyses.
